cause: The first sampling timestamp and waiting identities were captured only inside RAF. A CPU gap preceding the first RAF had no earlier interval to recover. Native play at time zero also precedes the legacy public playing getter becoming true.
resolution: Seed the private sampling window when a visible scheduler begins actual playback, before requesting RAF; repeated starts retain the anchor. Native unpaused/non-ended media with readyState > 2 can seed time zero. No public getter or dispatch semantics changed.
